chunks.title: Norfund (Norwegian Investment Fund / Climate Investment Fund) (Norfund) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Norfund (Norwegian Investment Fund / Climate Investment Fund) is a Bilateral DFI headquartered in Norway. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Co-launched '10by30' ($10B emerging market climate finance alliance) at COP31 on Nov 13 via Norwegian Climate Investment Fund. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Co-anchoring $10B '10by30' by 2030 (63% Africa portfolio; priority markets South Africa, Egypt, Tunisia, Morocco, India, SE Asia). Source verification: https://www.byteseu.com/2521383/.

chunks.title: Norfund Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Norfund (Norwegian Investment Fund / Climate Investment Fund) provides the following climate financing instruments: Equity, Mezzanine, Long-Term Debt, Co-Investment (10by30), Blended Finance. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 10,000,000 to USD 100,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Project SPV, Large Corporate, Financial Intermediary, Growth-Stage Private Enterprise.

chunks.title: Norfund Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Norfund (Norwegian Investment Fund / Climate Investment Fund): Renewable Energy, Energy Storage, Electrification & Grid, Industrial Decarbonization, Sustainable Fuels. Target geographic focus includes: Africa, South Africa, Egypt, Morocco, Tunisia, Asia, Latin America. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Norfund Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Norfund's application form: High avoided-emissions potential replacing fossil-fuel power; 10by30 coordinated due diligence & IFC Performance Standards; Norfund priority emerging markets (high-emitting developing countries); Clear additionality & private capital mobilization. Explicit exclusion rules: Fossil-fuel power plants; Coal mining. Official application portal: https://www.norfund.no/apply-for-funding/.

chunks.title: Norfund Form Template: Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form
chunks.text: Norfund (Norwegian Investment Fund / Climate Investment Fund) uses the 'Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form' workflow governed by IFC Performance Standards / Harmonized DFI Climate Reporting (10by30 / IDFC). Typical review timeline is 4–12 weeks (Screening -> Due Diligence -> Credit Committee). Form sections required: 1. Sponsor Profile, 2. Transaction Structure, 3. Climate & Impact, 4. Financial Due Diligence, 5. Risk Assessment, 6. Executive Summary.
